summary: This directory provides a centralized infrastructure for file system operations, including path normalization, file accessibility management, and advanced searching capabilities within the project's internal file structures.
responsibilities: Normalize file system paths for consistent usage
Manage secure file access and synchronization
Perform file discovery using search queries and metadata filtering
relationships: The FileSearchService utilizes search queries to locate files within the file system.
The FileAccessService manages concurrent file operations to ensure data integrity during access.
EntryPath and FsPath provide consistent type definitions used by all services to represent locations within the file system.
designDecisions: Standardization of path strings to use forward slashes
Service-based abstraction for file system interactions
Centralized type definitions for path representations
